grid.title: Voice Providers

providers.openai: OpenAI TTS — high-quality voices via api.openai.com.
providers.openaiCompatible: Any OpenAI-format TTS API — custom endpoint, free model selection.
providers.cartesia: Cartesia Sonic — ultra-low latency neural TTS, API key required.

providers.azureSpeech: Azure Cognitive Services TTS — neural voices, API key + region required.
